native_mechanisms: Nightingales released down every road, singing one note per stride and dying at the first board, carving that board's lattice slot with the dying note (per-edge distance propagation with min-kept arrival label, dead roads marked once and never re-sent)

A cow's-head woman at each board milks a smaller cow to re-measure the note via the last settled board, recutting the slot only if her milk is thinner (relaxation of the tentative label through the newly settled node, keep if smaller)

Always settle next the unsettled slot holding the quietest note, never revisit a settled board, unreached places stay blank as the desert (global minimum selection over the fixed-slot lattice, permanent settling, INFINITY for unreachable)
core_technique: Dijkstra's algorithm over CSR adjacency with a dense O(n^2) linear-scan minimum selection plus array relaxation, switched by a size/density heuristic to a standard binary-heap Dijkstra for large sparse graphs.
